name: tellescope_banner
description: Links the patient chart to the patient's profile in Tellescope: a chart banner built from a URL-template setting, and a chart app that opens the profile in the right pane (found through the Tellescope API, or the same template). With no valid setting, no banner or link is shown.

handlers.description: Adds, refreshes or removes the Tellescope profile banner when a patient or their external identifier changes.

applications.name: Tellescope Profile
applications.description: Open the patient's linked Tellescope profile in the chart pane.
